text_block_list.text: —One day, with the Kikuka Sho drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ââPhew.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Looking great.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Seems you're working hard.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Her running is completely different from before.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder how Orfe saw it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Stronger. Sharper. Heavier.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Even I'm surprised myself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Because it was entrusted to me, then?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-san has taught me
so very many things...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Orfe.
We really are connected, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not quite right...
—Perhaps I should say, we are bound to connect.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: As if the world goes on forever.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just as Big Sis's words brought me my fateful connections.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just as you and I... are family.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as Elder Sister received
guidance from the Mejiro family, huh."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
That's exactly right—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I shall strive to show something worthy to Or as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What I'm becoming certain of right now... is that very power.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...My interest is piqued.
And on the day of the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The Tiara route tends to get all the attention this year, but I'm really putting my hopes on Dream Journey!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see what kind of running she'll show us
in her first long-distance race...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—The race known as the Kikuka Sho
is somewhat special to me.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"To be precise...
it is for the bonds that surround me."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It was the very first GⅠ race McQueen-san challenged and emerged victorious in, and—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The race that is still talked about to this day,
said to have heralded the beginning of her breakthrough.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—And for Big Sis, her very first
GⅠ had also been the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: In that race, Matikanefukukitaru-san claimed victory with an astonishing final spurt, while Anego finished out of the money, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...She was simply smiling with pure joy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Even now, I can vividly recall that smile—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...And today, I run in the Kikuka Sho.
choice_data_list: Hearing that, I really feel a sense of destiny.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Right? And that is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――Half-hearted running will not be tolerated.
For a split second, it felt as though the air in the room turned ice-cold—

Dream Journey radiated an intense, unmistakable
intimidating aura and sharp fighting spirit...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I will show them.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: The fruits of our diligent training.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy yourself to the fullest.
